thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate across gateway (region: us-west-2). Alerting SRE.
alice.m: Ack, on it. Jumping into logs now. Pager link: https://pagerduty.com/incident/INC-9428
ben.s: I'm paged too, joining. Any deployments in last 30m?
deploy-bot: Recent config change: envoy-route-update v2025-08-17-18:14 (commit 0a9f3b). Applied to lb-service-prod at 18:05 UTC.
carla.p: Heads up: customer success reporting increased errors from a few enterprise customers.
alice.m: Seeing a spike in 502/504 from Envoy. Upstream services healthy per app metrics. Error traces show upstream reset and 503 from Envoy when retry loop is triggered.
ben.s: Graphs: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/gateway?var-region=us-west-2 - 5xx rate up from 0.2% -> 6.1% since 18:05 UTC :eyes:
alice.m: Suspecting route/retry change in v2025-08-17-18:14. The new retry policy added 3 retries for idempotent requests and circuit-breaker thresholds lowered.
alice.m: Reproduced locally with curl -v -> saw Envoy respond 503 after retry attempts with upstream connection resets.
ben.s: Can we temporarily disable retries on gateway to break the retry amplification? That should stop overload and reduce 5xx.
carla.p: I'll prepare customer comms template. Need ETA for mitigation update.
alice.m: Executing mitigation: rolling out a quick env var override to disable retries on route 'api-generate' and lifting CB to previous thresholds.
alice.m: Command:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/lb-service PROD_ENVOY_RETRIES=0 --record
kubectl -n infra patch cm envoy-route-config -p '{"data":{"api-generate-retries":"0","cb-max-connections":"2000"}}'
``` 
deploy-bot: Patch accepted, initiating hot-reload of Envoy config (rolling restarts across nodes).
sre-pager: Noted. I am assigning incident to alice.m as primary and ben.s as secondary.
ben.s: Monitoring... latency looks stable, 5xx trending down after ~2 minutes. Still seeing some residual 502s.
alice.m: Rolling back the specific route commit as a precaution (undo v2025-08-17-18:14 for lb-service-prod). Command:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment lb-service-prod --to-revision=42
```
deploy-bot: Rollout undo started. Progressing.. node-3 restarting envoy proxy.
alice.m: After undo and disabling retries, 5xx down to 0.4% in us-west-2. Customers reporting fewer errors. :thumbsup:
carla.p: Sending initial customer advisory: "We identified transient gateway errors tied to a recent load balancer config change. We have rolled back the change and applied mitigations; service is stabilizing. We'll follow up with a root cause update." Will post in #customer-updates.
ben.s: Logging incident timeline and saving relevant traces: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2025-08-17/INC-9428/
alice.m: Temporary mitigation in place. Next steps: revert the route change in config repo (PR) with tests to prevent retry amplification, add canary gating for route/cb changes, and run chaos-tests for retry policies.
dave.t: I'm coming on shift in 20 min to pick up handoff. Any outstanding actions?
alice.m: Handoff notes: mitigation done, rollback applied, monitoring green but alerting still on for 5xx. Postmortem owner: ben.s. Action items: PR to revert config + unit tests (ben.s), add dashboard alert for retry amplification (alice.m), customer follow-up (carla.p).
dave.t: Roger, will monitor and follow up. If anything spikes, I'll page the on-call team.
incident-bot: Incident INC-9428 transitioned to status: mitigation in place. Paging suppressed for now.
carla.p: Filed a brief incident status update to the status page.
ben.s: I'll open the postmortem doc and assign timeline + owners.
alice.m: Thanks everyone. Great quick coordination. :raised_hands:
carla.p: will draft a short blameless RCA and link to commit 0a9f3b for context.
ben.s: Closing on-call shift notes. Leaving logs and commands in the incident folder.
alice.m: Last check: 5xx stable <0.5% for 15m. I'll mark as monitoring and hand to dave for watch.
dave.t: Taking handoff. I'll keep channel updated if anything changes. :eyes:
incident-bot: Incident INC-9428: last update at 1745002870. Severity: Sev2. Mitigation: retries disabled + route rollback. Owner: ben.s."
